summary: The core conditional contradiction in (15) is largely supported, but the candidate overstates the consequence of (17) by dropping the retained-trace hypothesis, and equation (25) contains an undefined quantity.
critical_errors: Equation (17) alone only yields the third condition in (15), namely |B_{rs}|\le\Phi_{rs}. The contradiction proving (15) also requires the retained-trace condition (11). Nothing in (17), (19), or (16) implies that the two axis sections of D_{rs} retain the Q-traces. Therefore the subsequent assertion that (17) itself excludes the stated breakpoint-density class, including the triangular example as stated, is not proved without explicitly retaining hypothesis (11).
gaps: The area identity (25) uses \nu_0, which is never defined. The identity and the application of (23) require this factor to be u_0. As written, the displayed computation is not well-formed.
repair_hints: State the consequence of (17) only for a row whose traces are retained as in (11) and whose separator is nondegenerate.
Replace the undefined \nu_0 in (25) by u_0.
